Visit note | 2025-06-15 04:30 PM | Dr. Rezaul Karim, Neurology | Patient: Fahim Bepari, 75, male. Mr. Bepari attends this follow-up visit reporting that he continues to experience tingling like pins and needles and burning in both feet, with the symptoms getting worse at night. She works as a fisherman. Medical history includes Bronchial asthma, which is currently stable. She reports no severe pelvic pain or abnormal hair growth, though cycles have been irregular. On clinical examination, her BMI is 32.8. Other vital signs include blood pressure of 113/72 mmHg, pulse rate of 87 beats per minute, and weight of 45 kg. Heart and lung sounds are clear.
